title: Valuables Schedule Points Applied to a RentGuard Discount Restart
content:
Rating schedule — restart schedule points, RentGuard Renters Policy. When the multi-policy discount on a renters policy restarts because a new qualifying policy took effect, the scheduled total of a new Larkspur Valuables Floater adds points to the discount percentages after the restart.

**Rule.** When the new qualifying policy is a Larkspur Valuables Floater whose scheduled total is 25000.00 USD or more, 2 points are added to the discount percentages after the restart; when its scheduled total is 10000.00 USD or more but below 25000.00 USD, 1 point is added; in every other case no schedule points are added.

| New qualifying policy | Scheduled total on the floater record | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Valuables Floater | 25000.00 or more | 2 |
| Larkspur Valuables Floater | 10000.00 to 24999.99 | 1 |
| Larkspur Valuables Floater | below 10000.00 | 0 |
| Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy | not applicable | 0 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** A floater scheduling exactly 25000.00 USD adds 2 points; one scheduling 24999.99 USD adds 1 point. A floater scheduling exactly 10000.00 USD adds 1 point; 9999.99 USD adds none.
